description: Translate the Dorulumon standoff and the Chibickmon misunderstanding.

english:
Heh-heh! That's
up to the
doggy! Stop
fooling around
and hurry up
and catch
Spadamon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english: D-Dorulumon...!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Don't struggle!
Be a good
kitty!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Don't whine! Do
what I say,
meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
...Tch!
Remember this,
Minervamon! I
won't let this
end here!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Keep your mouth
shut, doggy.
Your breath
stinks!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Hey, wait,
Dorulumon! This
has to be a
joke...!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
I never thought
we'd have to
fight you like
this... But I
can't abandon
Cutemon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Heh-heh...
Great, just
great! If this
keeps up, ROG
will find the
Legendary
Ancient Weapons
and take over
the world!
Yee-haw!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Honestly, this
doggy is
completely
useless! How
will I face
Lord Zeed
Millenniummon?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
You guys aren't
needed here
anymore. Just
leave them and
go home!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Meow! We'll
leave them
behind, meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Meow! We're
going home,
meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english: Dorulumon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english: ...Cutemon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Using your
friends as
hostages to
make them
fight... What a
dirty trick!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
So that's why
you took
Chibickmon,
too! You
planned to use
it for
something!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
...Ha ha!
That's a pretty
nasty
accusation,
kid. Capturing
Spadamon is my
lousy job;
playing with
that one was
the best fun!
Why would I use
such a cute
thing for
anything?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Then why did
you take it
away? What were
you trying to
do?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
I was just
playing with
Pukumon!
Kidnap, take
away, use, some
kind of plan...
What are you
even talking
about?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
No... Don't
lie. Were you
trying to steal
something...?
But Chibickmon
doesn't have
anything
important...
So... what else
could be
valuable...?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.

english:
Don't insult
Pukumon any
further! If you
look ugly, your
thoughts must
be ugly, too!
Nothing is more
precious than
that little
one's cuteness!
But no one can
ever take that
away! You're
filthy and
unpleasant, the
worst of the
worst! I can't
stand sharing
the same air
with you!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Pukumon and the other Digimon use established Western spellings.
